instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. In the center, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing away from the camera. On the right, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) kicks his right leg forward towards her hip. The studio is brightly lit by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
elements: R1 initiates the leg kick toward R2 rather than R2 kicking toward R1
R1's right leg is extended forward toward R2's hip
R2 is the recipient/target of R1's kick while standing facing away from the camera
R2 stands in the center as R1 performs the kicking action toward her
The interaction takes place in an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet
